notes.en: All-metal build typical of Leica SL primes; heavier than most 35mm f/2 lenses in this class.
notes.zh: 全金属机身是徕卡 SL 定焦头的典型做法，比同规格的大多数 35mm f/2 镜头更重。

notes.en: One of the launch lenses for the Leica SL system.
notes.zh: 徕卡 SL 系统的首发镜头之一。

notes.en: APO-corrected telephoto prime, praised for near-zero chromatic aberration.
notes.zh: APO 复消色差长焦定焦头，色差控制接近于零，广受好评。

notes.en: Standard zoom launch lens for the Leica SL system.
notes.zh: 徕卡 SL 系统的首发标准变焦头。

notes.en: Telephoto zoom counterpart to the 24-70mm launch lens.
notes.zh: 与 24-70mm 首发镜头搭配的长焦变焦头。

notes.en: Kit-style standard zoom for the Lumix S system with close-focus macro capability.
notes.zh: Lumix S 系统的套机式标准变焦头，具备近摄微距能力。

notes.en: Part of Panasonic's flagship PRO line co-engineered with Leica optical standards.
notes.zh: 松下旗舰 PRO 系列之一，与徕卡共同制定光学标准。

notes.en: Professional telephoto zoom with dual-mode dust/splash resistant construction.
notes.zh: 专业级长焦变焦头，采用双重防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: Compact, lightweight kit zoom bundled with entry-level Lumix S bodies.
notes.zh: 紧凑轻便的套机变焦头，常随入门级 Lumix S 机身搭售。

notes.en: Compact, budget-friendly portrait prime for the Lumix S line.
notes.zh: Lumix S 系列里紧凑、平价的人像定焦头。

notes.en: True 1:1 macro reproduction ratio in a compact, lightweight body.
notes.zh: 机身紧凑轻便，可实现真正的 1:1 微距放大倍率。

notes.en: Redesigned mirrorless-native version of Sigma's popular 35mm Art prime.
notes.zh: 适马人气 35mm Art 定焦头的无反原生重新设计版本。

notes.en: Popular for astro and landscape work due to low coma at f/1.4.
notes.zh: f/1.4 光圈下彗差控制出色，深受星空摄影和风光摄影爱好者喜爱。

notes.en: Part of the I-series all-metal compact prime lineup.
notes.zh: I 系列全金属紧凑定焦头阵容之一。

notes.en: Affordable super-telephoto zoom for wildlife and sports.
notes.zh: 价格亲民的超长焦变焦头，适合野生动物和体育摄影。

notes.en: Compact f/2.8 standard zoom, notably lighter than most competitors.
notes.zh: 紧凑型 f/2.8 标准变焦头，比大多数同类竞品更轻。

notes.en: 1:1 macro prime built to Sigma's Art-line optical standard.
notes.zh: 按适马 Art 系列光学标准打造的 1:1 微距定焦头。

notes.en: Flagship Sports-line super-telephoto zoom with 1:1 macro capability at 600mm.
notes.zh: Sports 系列旗舰超长焦变焦头，600mm 端也能实现 1:1 微距放大。

notes.en: Sirui's first full-frame autofocus lens and its debut L-Mount product, released alongside the brand joining the L-Mount Alliance.
notes.zh: 思锐首款全画幅自动对焦镜头，也是其加入 L-Mount Alliance 后推出的首款 L 卡口产品。

notes.en: Second Aurora-series lens, expanding the AF lineup to wide-angle; ships in Sony E, Nikon Z, Fuji X, and L-mount versions.
notes.zh: Aurora 系列第二款镜头，将自动对焦阵容扩展到广角端，提供索尼 E、尼康 Z、富士 X 和 L 卡口版本。

notes.en: All-manual budget prime with all-metal construction, offered in E/Z/RF/L. Distinct from the TTArtisan M 50mm F1.4, a separate Leica M rangefinder lens with a 0.7m close-focus limit. Weight varies by mount (429-457g); the figure shown is for L-mount. Maximum magnification is not published by the manufacturer and is a reviewer measurement.
notes.zh: 全金属结构的全手动平价定焦，提供 E/Z/RF/L 四种卡口。注意与 TTArtisan M 50mm F1.4 区分——后者是徕卡 M 旁轴镜头，最近对焦为 0.7m。重量随卡口不同（429–457g），此处为 L 卡口版数值。厂商未公布最大放大倍率，此处为评测实测值。

notes.en: Fast manual-focus wide-angle prime aimed at astro and landscape shooters. The L-mount version was sold from 2021 but has since been discontinued by TTArtisan; E/Z/RF versions remain. Filters mount at 72mm via the supplied holder. Maximum magnification is not published by the manufacturer and is an estimate.
notes.zh: 面向星空与风光的大光圈手动广角定焦。L 卡口版本自 2021 年发售，现已被 TTArtisan 停产，E/Z/RF 版本仍在售。通过随附的滤镜支架使用 72mm 滤镜。厂商未公布最大放大倍率，此处为估算值。

notes.en: Redesigned full-frame Mark III with an ED element and a 10-blade aperture. Among the 7Artisans 35mm f/1.4 lenses, only this full-frame version is offered in L-mount; the APS-C 35mm f/1.4 is not. Maximum magnification is not published by the manufacturer, so the value shown is an estimate.
notes.zh: 重新设计的全画幅 Mark III，含一枚 ED 镜片，10 片光圈叶片。在 7Artisans 的 35mm f/1.4 系列中，只有这支全画幅版本提供 L 卡口，APS-C 版本并不提供。厂商未公布最大放大倍率，此处数值为估算。

notes.en: Budget 1:1 manual-focus macro for APS-C bodies, internally focusing. Only the Mark II is offered in L-mount; the original 60mm f/2.8 was never made for L.
notes.zh: 面向 APS-C 机身的平价 1:1 手动对焦微距镜头，内对焦设计。仅 Mark II 提供 L 卡口版本，初代 60mm f/2.8 从未推出 L 卡口。

notes.en: Near-zero optical distortion ultra-wide, popular for architecture and astro. Introduced in 2017 for Sony FE; the L-mount version arrived in July 2020. Manual aperture ring, no electronic contacts. Minimum aperture could not be confirmed via Venus Optics' official channels, so the f/22 shown here is unverified.
notes.zh: 几乎零畸变的超广角镜头，常用于建筑与星空摄影。2017 年首发于索尼 FE，L 卡口版本于 2020 年 7 月推出。手动光圈环，无电子触点。最小光圈未能通过老蛙官方渠道核实，此处 f/22 的数值为未证实数据。

notes.en: Reaches 2:1 magnification, double a standard 1:1 macro lens. Only the Canon EF version has electronic aperture control; the L-mount version is fully manual, with aperture set on the lens ring. Venus Optics does not publish an L-mount weight — the figure shown is from retailer listings.
notes.zh: 可达 2:1 放大倍率，是常规 1:1 微距镜头的两倍。只有佳能 EF 版本具备电子光圈控制，L 卡口版本为全手动，光圈由镜身光圈环设定。厂商未公布 L 卡口版重量，此处数值取自零售商标注。

notes.en: APS-C ultra-wide constant-f/2.8 zoom whose weather sealing is limited to a rubber gasket at the mount rather than a full dust/splash-resistant barrel.
notes.zh: APS-C 画幅恒定 f/2.8 超广角变焦头，防护仅限于卡口处的橡胶密封圈，并非全金属桶身的防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: Ultra-wide full-frame f/2.8 zoom with a bulbous front element that precludes front filters, using a rear gel-filter holder instead.
notes.zh: 全画幅 f/2.8 超广角变焦头，前镜片呈球面凸起无法安装前置滤镜，改用后置凝胶滤镜插槽。

notes.en: Compact full-frame wide-angle zoom; independent reviews note the weather sealing is limited to a mount gasket rather than full barrel sealing.
notes.zh: 紧凑型全画幅广角变焦头；据多方评测，其防护仅限于卡口处密封圈，并非整支镜身的防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: 18.75x APS-C superzoom giving roughly 24-450mm full-frame-equivalent coverage in a single lens with OS2 stabilization.
notes.zh: 18.75 倍 APS-C 超级变焦头，单支镜头即可覆盖等效全画幅约 24-450mm 焦段，配备 OS2 防抖。

notes.en: Compact constant-f/2.8 standard zoom for APS-C, roughly equivalent to 27-75mm in full-frame terms; mount-only rubber sealing.
notes.zh: APS-C 画幅恒定 f/2.8 紧凑标准变焦头，等效全画幅约 27-75mm，仅卡口处有橡胶密封。

notes.en: Marketed as the world's first full-frame 10x zoom for mirrorless; the official name omits OS and DN because it has no in-lens stabilization and relies on in-body IS.
notes.zh: 官方宣传为全球首款全画幅无反 10 倍变焦头；官方型号名省略了 OS 和 DN 字样，因为它没有镜头内防抖，依赖机身防抖。

notes.en: Original DG DN Art standard zoom (later joined by a lighter 24-70mm F2.8 DG DN II Art in 2024); notable for higher magnification at the wide end than the tele end.
notes.zh: 初代 DG DN Art 标准变焦头（2024 年推出更轻的 24-70mm F2.8 DG DN II Art 后继续在售）；广角端的放大倍率反而高于长焦端。

notes.en: World's first full-frame zoom with a constant F1.8 maximum aperture across its entire focal range.
notes.zh: 全球首款全焦段恒定 F1.8 光圈的全画幅变焦头。

notes.en: Constant-f/2.8 standard-to-telephoto zoom that maintains a fixed 0.40m minimum focus distance across the entire focal range.
notes.zh: 恒定 f/2.8 标准至中长焦变焦头，全焦段最近对焦距离都固定在 0.40 米。

notes.en: 10x super-telephoto zoom reaching 600mm, with peak 0.417x magnification achieved around 200mm rather than at either zoom extreme.
notes.zh: 10 倍超长焦变焦头，最长可达 600mm；0.417 倍的最大放大倍率出现在约 200mm 焦段，而非两端极值处。

notes.en: Constant-f/2.8 telephoto zoom with unusually worse close-focus at the tele end (1.00m) than at the wide end (0.65m).
notes.zh: 恒定 f/2.8 长焦变焦头，比较特殊的是长焦端（1.00 米）最近对焦距离反而比广角端（0.65 米）更远。

notes.en: Samyang's first L-Mount Alliance lens, a weather-sealed f/2-2.8 varying-aperture zoom released in July 2024.
notes.zh: 三阳/森养首款 L-Mount Alliance 镜头，2024 年 7 月发布，防尘防滴，光圈随焦段在 f/2 至 f/2.8 间变化。

notes.en: Viltrox's first L-Mount Alliance lens, a weather-sealed ultra-wide prime released in February 2026.
notes.zh: 唯卓仕首款 L-Mount Alliance 镜头，2026 年 2 月发布，防尘防滴的超广角定焦头。

notes.en: Part of 7Artisans' newer AF autofocus lineup (distinct from its older manual-focus lenses); not weather sealed; L-mount version released September 2025.
notes.zh: 属于七工匠较新的 AF 自动对焦系列（区别于其早期的手动对焦镜头）；不具备防尘防滴；L 卡口版本于 2025 年 9 月发布。

notes.en: 7Artisans' AF autofocus 35mm prime (distinct from the older manual-focus 7Artisans 35mm f/1.4); has only a mount-area gasket rather than full weather sealing; maximum magnification is a best estimate based on its 0.4m minimum focus distance since no official figure was published.
notes.zh: 七工匠 AF 自动对焦 35mm 定焦头（区别于旧款手动对焦的七工匠 35mm f/1.4）；仅卡口处有密封圈，非全面防尘防滴；由于官方未公布最大放大倍率数据，此处数值是根据 0.4 米最近对焦距离估算得出。

notes.en: 7Artisans' first-ever autofocus lens; not weather sealed; the L-mount version was released in April 2025, after the original Sony E-mount launch.
notes.zh: 七工匠首款自动对焦镜头；不具备防尘防滴；L 卡口版本于 2025 年 4 月发布，晚于索尼 E 卡口首发。

notes.en: 7Artisans' AF autofocus portrait prime; not weather sealed; the L-mount version was released in May 2025, after the original Sony E-mount launch.
notes.zh: 七工匠 AF 自动对焦人像定焦头；不具备防尘防滴；L 卡口版本于 2025 年 5 月发布，晚于索尼 E 卡口首发。

notes.en: TTArtisan's first autofocus L-Mount lens, a compact all-metal pancake-style prime with a USB-C firmware port; maximum magnification is a best estimate since TTArtisan does not publish an official figure.
notes.zh: 铭匠光学首款自动对焦 L 卡口镜头，紧凑饼干头造型，全金属机身，配备 USB-C 固件升级接口；由于官方未公布最大放大倍率数据，此处为估算值。

notes.en: TTArtisan's first full-frame lens and second autofocus L-Mount prime; all-metal build with no weather sealing or stabilization; maximum magnification is a best estimate since TTArtisan does not publish an official figure.
notes.zh: 铭匠光学首款全画幅镜头，也是其第二款自动对焦 L 卡口定焦头；全金属机身，不具备防尘防滴或防抖；由于官方未公布最大放大倍率数据，此处为估算值。

notes.en: Official Leica datasheet lists 386 g weight (without hood), E67 filter thread, and a 0.2 m working distance across the zoom range.
notes.zh: 徕卡官方数据表标注重量 386 克（不含遮光罩）、E67 滤镜口径，全焦段工作距离为 0.2 米。

notes.en: Official Leica datasheet lists 990 g weight, E82 filter thread, no built-in optical image stabilization, and dust/moisture-sealed construction.
notes.zh: 徕卡官方数据表标注重量 990 克、E82 滤镜口径，无内置光学防抖，具备防尘防潮密封结构。

notes.en: Official Leica datasheet lists 256 g weight (without hood), E52 filter thread, and maximum magnification of 1:7.5 at 56mm.
notes.zh: 徕卡官方数据表标注重量 256 克（不含遮光罩）、E52 滤镜口径，56mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:7.5。

notes.en: Official Leica datasheet lists 1140 g weight, E82 filter thread, integrated multi-axis optical image stabilization rated at 3.5 stops (CIPA), and dust/moisture-sealed construction.
notes.zh: 徕卡官方数据表标注重量 1140 克、E82 滤镜口径，内置多轴光学防抖（CIPA 标准约 3.5 档），具备防尘防潮密封结构。

notes.en: Official Leica datasheet lists 500 g weight (without hood), E60 filter thread, and maximum magnification of 1:8.0 at 135mm with apochromatic correction.
notes.zh: 徕卡官方数据表标注重量 500 克（不含遮光罩）、E60 滤镜口径，135mm 端配合复消色差校正可达 1:8.0 最大放大倍率。

notes.en: Variable-aperture full-frame telephoto zoom with built-in multi-axis optical stabilization (rated approximately 4 stops) and gasketed weather sealing.
notes.zh: 光圈可变的全画幅长焦变焦头，内置多轴光学防抖（约 4 档），配备防尘防潮密封垫圈。

notes.en: Pancake-style APS-C wide-angle prime (27mm full-frame equivalent) with an all-metal barrel and no weather sealing.
notes.zh: 饼干头造型的 APS-C 广角定焦头（等效全画幅约 27mm），全金属镜身，不具备防尘防滴。

notes.en: World's first APO-corrected 21mm full-frame prime, using a Dual Synchro Drive autofocus motor and AquaDura weather-sealed coating.
notes.zh: 全球首款复消色差校正的全画幅 21mm 定焦头，采用双重同步驱动自动对焦马达和 AquaDura 防水涂层。

notes.en: APS-C standard prime with a 35mm full-frame-equivalent field of view, originally launched for the Leica T.
notes.zh: APS-C 标准定焦头，等效全画幅约 35mm 视角，最初为徕卡 T 系统而生。

notes.en: Fast APS-C prime equivalent to 52.5mm, Leica's brightest native TL-mount lens with an internal focusing design.
notes.zh: 大光圈 APS-C 定焦头，等效全画幅约 52.5mm，是徕卡原生 TL 卡口镜头中光圈最大的一款，采用内对焦设计。

notes.en: Apochromatic prime with Dual Syncro Drive stepping-motor autofocus, dust/moisture sealing, and no built-in image stabilization, released 2019.
notes.zh: 复消色差定焦头，配备双重同步驱动步进马达自动对焦，具备防尘防潮密封，无内置防抖，2019 年发布。

notes.en: Lighter, non-apochromatic redesign released 2023, roughly half the weight of the earlier APO-Summicron-SL 50mm f/2, with no built-in image stabilization.
notes.zh: 2023 年发布的更轻量、非复消色差重新设计版本，重量约为早期 APO-Summicron-SL 50mm f/2 的一半，无内置防抖。

notes.en: Apochromatic 12-element/10-group design announced August 2019, predating the lighter non-APO Summicron-SL 50mm f/2 released in 2023; no built-in image stabilization.
notes.zh: 2019 年 8 月发布的复消色差 12 片 10 组光学结构，早于 2023 年发布的更轻量非 APO 版 Summicron-SL 50mm f/2；无内置防抖。

notes.en: True 1:1 macro prime for T/TL/CL APS-C mount, announced September 2016, lacks weather sealing and built-in stabilization.
notes.zh: 面向 T/TL/CL APS-C 卡口的真 1:1 微距定焦头，2016 年 9 月发布，不具备防尘防滴或内置防抖。

notes.en: Apochromatic portrait prime announced January 2018 with sealed metal housing and Dual Syncro Drive autofocus, no built-in image stabilization.
notes.zh: 复消色差人像定焦头，2018 年 1 月发布，配备密封金属机身和双重同步驱动自动对焦，无内置防抖。

notes.en: Designed primarily for astrophotography, it has a built-in tripod collar and a rear gel-filter holder instead of a front filter thread.
notes.zh: 主要面向星空摄影设计，内置三脚架环，并配备后置凝胶滤镜插槽而非前置滤镜口。

notes.en: Originally released for DSLR mounts in 2017, Sigma later added a native L-Mount SKU that retains the older HSM autofocus motor rather than a DN linear motor.
notes.zh: 最初于 2017 年为单反卡口发布，适马后续推出的原生 L 卡口版本仍保留旧款 HSM 自动对焦马达，而非 DN 直线马达。

model: 15mm F1.4 DG DN Diagonal Fisheye Art

notes.en: The world's first 180-degree diagonal fisheye lens for full-frame mirrorless with an f/1.4 maximum aperture.
notes.zh: 全球首款光圈达 f/1.4 的全画幅 180 度对角鱼眼镜头。

notes.en: Roughly a 24mm-equivalent field of view on APS-C, making it a popular fast wide-angle prime for Sigma fp/fp L crop-mode and other L-Mount APS-C bodies.
notes.zh: 在 APS-C 画幅上等效约 24mm 视角，是适马 fp/fp L 裁切模式及其他 L 卡口 APS-C 机身上颇受欢迎的大光圈广角定焦头。

notes.en: Part of Sigma's compact all-metal I-series, it has an unusually close 12cm minimum focus distance for a 17mm lens.
notes.zh: 适马紧凑型全金属 I 系列成员，作为 17mm 定焦头，其 12 厘米的最近对焦距离十分出色。

notes.en: Features a rear filter holder, manual focus lock switch, and lens heater retainer aimed at astrophotographers.
notes.zh: 配备后置滤镜插槽、手动对焦锁定开关和镜头加热器固定环，专为星空摄影设计。

notes.en: A compact, budget-friendly companion to the 20mm F1.4 Art, weighing less than half as much.
notes.zh: 20mm F1.4 Art 的紧凑平价搭档，重量不到其一半。

notes.en: Roughly a 35mm-equivalent field of view on APS-C, giving a fast standard-ish prime for L-Mount crop-sensor shooting.
notes.zh: 在 APS-C 画幅上等效约 35mm 视角，为 L 卡口画幅拍摄提供了一支大光圈的准标头。

notes.en: Announced alongside the 90mm F2.8 DG DN Contemporary as a matched compact pair.
notes.zh: 与 90mm F2.8 DG DN Contemporary 同期发布，组成一对紧凑搭档。

notes.en: Part of the compact I-series line, notable for an unusually high 1:2 maximum magnification for a 24mm lens.
notes.zh: 紧凑型 I 系列成员，作为 24mm 定焦头，1:2 的最大放大倍率相当罕见。

notes.en: Originally launched in 2016 for other mounts; the native L-Mount version arrived in mid-2020 with dust and splash resistance added.
notes.zh: 最初于 2016 年为其他卡口推出，原生 L 卡口版本于 2020 年中上市，并加入了防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: The original first-generation model, now discontinued and succeeded by the smaller, lighter 35mm F1.2 DG II Art.
notes.zh: 初代设计，现已停产，由更小更轻的 35mm F1.2 DG II Art 接替。

notes.en: Second-generation redesign that is about 30 percent lighter than the original, with a smaller 72mm filter thread and dual linear-motor autofocus.
notes.zh: 第二代重新设计版本，比初代轻约 30%，滤镜口径缩小至 72mm，配备双直线马达自动对焦。

notes.en: Part of the original three-lens I-series launch alongside the 24mm F3.5 and 65mm F2.
notes.zh: 与 24mm F3.5、65mm F2 同属初代三支一组的 I 系列首发阵容。

notes.en: Announced in 2018 for DSLR mounts and Sony E; a native L-Mount SKU began shipping in December 2019 and remains a DG HSM design, not DG DN.
notes.zh: 2018 年为单反卡口和索尼 E 卡口发布；原生 L 卡口版本于 2019 年 12 月上市，仍为 DG HSM 设计而非 DG DN。

notes.en: An ultra-compact all-metal pancake-style prime, also sold in a silver colorway.
notes.zh: 超紧凑全金属饼干头造型定焦头，也有银色款可选。

notes.en: A ground-up mirrorless-native redesign of Sigma's classic 50mm F1.4 Art, considerably smaller and lighter than the original DSLR-era version.
notes.zh: 对适马经典 50mm F1.4 Art 定焦头进行的无反原生彻底重新设计，比单反时代版本明显更小更轻。

notes.en: A budget-friendly compact standard prime completing the F2 DG DN Contemporary trio with the 24mm and 90mm.
notes.zh: 平价紧凑标准定焦头，与 24mm、90mm 共同组成 F2 DG DN Contemporary 三件套。

notes.en: Roughly an 84mm-equivalent field of view on APS-C, making it a popular fast portrait prime for L-Mount crop bodies.
notes.zh: 在 APS-C 画幅上等效约 84mm 视角，是 L 卡口画幅机身上颇受欢迎的大光圈人像定焦头。

notes.en: A true 1:1 macro lens; Sigma deliberately omitted optical stabilization to prioritize optical performance, and sealing is limited to a mount gasket rather than full-barrel weather resistance.
notes.zh: 真 1:1 微距定焦头；适马为优先保证光学素质，特意未加入光学防抖，防护也仅限于卡口处密封圈而非整支镜身的防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: A compact I-series short telephoto prime; sealing is limited to a mount gasket rather than full-barrel weather resistance.
notes.zh: 紧凑型 I 系列中长焦定焦头；防护仅限于卡口处密封圈，并非整支镜身的防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: Nicknamed the 'Bokeh Master'; announced in 2018 for DSLR mounts, with a native L-Mount SKU following in December 2019 while retaining the DG HSM (not DG DN) designation.
notes.zh: 绰号"虚化大师"；2018 年为单反卡口发布，原生 L 卡口版本于 2019 年 12 月跟进，仍保留 DG HSM（而非 DG DN）设计。

notes.en: The world's first autofocus 135mm F1.4 lens; Sigma's official global name omits the usual 'DN' suffix despite being mirrorless-native only.
notes.zh: 全球首款自动对焦 135mm F1.4 镜头；适马官方型号名省略了常见的"DN"后缀，尽管它是纯无反原生设计。

notes.en: The world's first F2 200mm prime for full-frame mirrorless, a completely new design offering up to 6.5 stops of stabilization.
notes.zh: 全球首款全画幅无反 F2 光圈 200mm 定焦头，全新设计，最高可提供 6.5 档防抖效果。

notes.en: A remarkably lightweight super-telephoto prime for its class at 1,370g, offering up to 5.0 stops of stabilization.
notes.zh: 同规格中格外轻便的超长焦定焦头，仅重 1370 克，最高可提供 5.0 档防抖效果。

notes.en: Meike's fastest wide-angle AF prime, announced August 2025. Minimum aperture (f/16) is confirmed; Meike's official page does not publish a weight figure for the L-mount version, so the 550g shown here could not be confirmed via official channels.
notes.zh: 美科目前最快的广角自动对焦定焦头，2025 年 8 月发布。最小光圈（f/16）已确认；美科官方页面未公布 L 卡口版本的重量数据，此处 550 克的数值未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Entry-level AF wide prime launched September 2024 for Sony E, Nikon Z and L mount. Minimum aperture (f/22) is confirmed; weight could not be confirmed via Meike's official channels, so the 300g shown here is unverified.
notes.zh: 入门级自动对焦广角定焦头，2024 年 9 月发布，提供索尼 E、尼康 Z 和 L 卡口版本。最小光圈（f/22）已确认；重量未能通过美科官方渠道核实，此处 300 克的数值为未证实数据。

notes.en: Pro-tier redesign of Meike's 35mm STM lens with a metal body and click-stop aperture ring, released July 2025 for E/Z/L mounts. Minimum aperture (f/16) is confirmed; Meike's official page does not publish a weight figure, so the 400g shown here could not be confirmed via official channels.
notes.zh: 美科 35mm STM 定焦头的 Pro 升级版，金属机身配合有级光圈环，2025 年 7 月发布，提供 E/Z/L 卡口版本。最小光圈（f/16）已确认；美科官方页面未公布重量数据，此处 400 克的数值未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Budget standard AF prime added to L-mount in July 2024.
notes.zh: 平价标准自动对焦定焦头，2024 年 7 月加入 L 卡口阵容。

notes.en: Pro-tier 55mm AF prime announced October 2024 for E/Z/L mounts, using a stepping motor with an auxiliary focus drive system. Minimum aperture (f/16) is confirmed; Meike's official page does not publish a weight figure, so the 364g shown here could not be confirmed via official channels.
notes.zh: Pro 系列 55mm 自动对焦定焦头，2024 年 10 月发布，提供 E/Z/L 卡口版本，采用步进马达配合辅助对焦驱动系统。最小光圈（f/16）已确认；美科官方页面未公布重量数据，此处 364 克的数值未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Meike's first budget 85mm f/1.4 AF prime, with the L-mount SKU confirmed shipping in July 2024.
notes.zh: 美科首款平价 85mm f/1.4 自动对焦定焦头，L 卡口版本已确认于 2024 年 7 月开售。

notes.en: Second-generation 85mm f/1.4 'MIX' lens with a redesigned optical formula, officially released for E/Z/L mounts in May 2026.
notes.zh: 第二代 85mm f/1.4 "MIX" 定焦头，重新设计光学结构，2026 年 5 月正式发布，提供 E/Z/L 卡口版本。

notes.en: Meike's original 85mm f/1.8 AF portrait prime; also sold under the 'SE' name once the Pro tier launched (treated here as the same optical lens, not a separate SKU).
notes.zh: 美科最初的 85mm f/1.8 自动对焦人像定焦头；Pro 系列推出后也曾以"SE"命名销售（此处视为同一支光学镜头，不作为独立型号收录）。

notes.en: Pro-tier 85mm f/1.8 AF prime with a redesigned optical formula and click-stop aperture ring, announced November 2024 for E/Z/L mounts.
notes.zh: Pro 系列 85mm f/1.8 自动对焦定焦头，重新设计光学结构并配备有级光圈环，2024 年 11 月发布，提供 E/Z/L 卡口版本。

notes.en: Unusually for an ultra-wide zoom, it has a conventional 77mm front filter thread and 0.5x macro magnification at the tele end.
notes.zh: 作为一支超广角变焦头较为少见地配备了常规 77mm 前置滤镜口径，长焦端可实现 0.5 倍微距放大。

notes.en: A constant-f/4 PRO-series wide-angle zoom launched alongside the original LUMIX S1/S1R system.
notes.zh: 恒定 f/4 光圈的 PRO 系列广角变焦头，随初代 LUMIX S1/S1R 系统一同发布。

notes.en: Marketed by Panasonic as the world's smallest and lightest full-frame L-Mount zoom at launch, designed as a kit lens for the compact LUMIX S9.
notes.zh: 松下宣传为发布时全球最小最轻的全画幅 L 卡口变焦头，是专为紧凑机身 LUMIX S9 设计的套机镜头。

notes.en: A lighter, more compact constant-f/2.8 standard zoom released in 2025 alongside the LUMIX S1II/S1IIE, distinct from the earlier LUMIX S PRO 24-70mm F2.8.
notes.zh: 2025 年随 LUMIX S1II/S1IIE 一同发布的更轻巧紧凑的恒定 f/2.8 标准变焦头，区别于早期的 LUMIX S PRO 24-70mm F2.8。

notes.en: The original constant-f/2.8 PRO standard zoom launched with the LUMIX S1/S1R system in 2019.
notes.zh: 初代恒定 f/2.8 PRO 标准变焦头，2019 年随 LUMIX S1/S1R 系统一同发布。

notes.en: An all-in-one 7.1x superzoom with 0.5x (1:2) macro magnification.
notes.zh: 一镜走天下的 7.1 倍超级变焦头，具备 0.5 倍（1:2）微距放大能力。

notes.en: The lighter, more compact companion to the LUMIX S PRO 70-200mm F2.8, launched with the original S1/S1R system in 2019.
notes.zh: LUMIX S PRO 70-200mm F2.8 的轻量紧凑版搭档，2019 年随初代 S1/S1R 系统一同发布。

notes.en: Reaches 0.5x (1:2) macro magnification at 300mm, making it a compact telephoto-macro hybrid with in-lens O.I.S.
notes.zh: 300mm 端可实现 0.5 倍（1:2）微距放大，是一支紧凑的长焦微距混合镜头，内置光学防抖。

notes.en: Panasonic's first ultra-telephoto zoom for the LUMIX S system, announced in September 2025 with a removable tripod collar.
notes.zh: 松下为 LUMIX S 系统推出的首款超长焦变焦头，2025 年 9 月发布，配备可拆卸脚架环。

notes.en: The widest lens in Panasonic's compact, matched-size S 1.8 prime series aimed at hybrid photo/video shooters.
notes.zh: 松下紧凑同规格 S 1.8 定焦系列中最广的一支，面向兼顾照片与视频拍摄的用户。

notes.en: Part of Panasonic's matched-size S 1.8 prime lineup, sharing external dimensions and controls with its siblings for gimbal use.
notes.zh: 松下同规格 S 1.8 定焦系列成员之一，与同系列其他镜头共享外形尺寸和操控布局，便于稳定器使用。

notes.en: A compact standard-wide prime in Panasonic's S 1.8 series, sharing a common 67mm filter thread and control layout with its siblings.
notes.zh: 松下 S 1.8 系列中紧凑的标准偏广角定焦头，与系列其他镜头共用 67mm 滤镜口径和操控布局。

notes.en: The newest and smallest lens in the S 1.8/f2 prime series, a pancake-style design with a fluorine-coated front element.
notes.zh: S 1.8/f2 定焦系列中最新、最小的一支，饼干头造型，前镜片带氟涂层。

notes.en: A compact, affordable standard prime that completes Panasonic's matched-size S 1.8 lens series.
notes.zh: 紧凑平价的标准定焦头，补全了松下同规格 S 1.8 镜头系列。

notes.en: Ultra-thin autofocus pancake weighing about 60g. The aperture is fixed at f/4.5: the lens has no diaphragm and cannot be stopped down, and it has no front filter thread. Autofocus only, with no manual focus ring. The L-mount version followed the Sony E and Fujifilm X versions in June 2026. The magnification figure is Viltrox’s own, published for the identical optical unit on the E-mount page.
notes.zh: 约 60g 的超薄自动对焦饼干头。光圈固定为 f/4.5——镜头没有光圈叶片，无法收缩光圈，也没有前置滤镜螺纹。仅支持自动对焦，没有手动对焦环。L 卡口版本于 2026 年 6 月推出，晚于索尼 E 和富士 X 版本。放大倍率取自唯卓仕为同一光学结构在 E 卡口页面公布的数值。

notes.en: Manual tilt lens giving ±8° of tilt, with the tilt axis rotatable through 90°. It tilts only and does not shift. Fully mechanical: manual focus, manual aperture ring, no electronic contacts and no EXIF. Leica L was one of the two launch mounts in October 2022. Distinct from the TTArtisan 50mm F1.4 ASPH and from the Leica M-mount M 50mm F1.4. The manufacturer does not publish a magnification figure; the value shown is a reviewer measurement.
notes.zh: 手动倾角镜头，可实现 ±8° 倾角，倾轴可旋转 90°。只有倾角，没有平移。全机械结构：手动对焦、机械光圈环、无电子触点、不记录 EXIF。徕卡 L 是 2022 年 10 月首发的两个卡口之一。注意与 TTArtisan 50mm F1.4 ASPH 以及徕卡 M 卡口的 M 50mm F1.4 区分。厂商未公布最大放大倍率，此处为评测实测值。

notes.en: Constant-F4 super-telephoto zoom with optical stabilization and a rear drop-in filter holder (40.5mm) instead of a front filter thread. Minimum focus is 2.8m at 300mm and 4.5m at 600mm.
notes.zh: 恒定 F4 光圈的超长焦变焦镜头，带光学防抖；无前置滤镜螺纹，改用后置插入式滤镜座（40.5mm）。最近对焦距离 300mm 端 2.8m、600mm 端 4.5m。

notes.en: Constant-F1.8 APS-C standard zoom with internal zooming, succeeding the 18-35mm F1.8 DC HSM Art. Maximum magnification 1:4.8 at 40mm.
notes.zh: 恒定 F1.8 光圈的 APS-C 标准变焦镜头，内变焦设计，是 18-35mm F1.8 DC HSM Art 的后继型号。40mm 端最大放大倍率 1:4.8。

notes.en: Second version of the 35mm F1.4 DG DN Art, shorter and lighter, with dual linear-motor autofocus and an 11-blade aperture.
notes.zh: 35mm F1.4 DG DN Art 的第二代，镜身更短更轻，采用双直线马达自动对焦和 11 片光圈叶片。

notes.en: F1.2 portrait prime with dual linear-motor autofocus and a 13-blade aperture, weighing 905g in L-Mount.
notes.zh: F1.2 大光圈人像定焦镜头，双直线马达自动对焦，13 片光圈叶片，L 卡口版重 905g。

notes.en: Compact variable-aperture standard zoom starting at 20mm, weighing 385g in L-Mount. Close focus of 15.8cm at 28mm gives up to 1:2.3 magnification at 35mm; minimum aperture is F22-32.
notes.zh: 起始焦段为 20mm 的小巧浮动光圈标准变焦镜头，L 卡口版重 385g。28mm 端最近对焦 15.8cm，35mm 端最大放大倍率 1:2.3；最小光圈 F22-32。

notes.en: The lightest and most compact zoom in the SL lineup at 572 g. Close focus is 0.19 m at 28mm (1:3.3) and 0.38 m at 70mm.
notes.zh: SL 系列中最轻、最紧凑的变焦镜头，重 572 g。28mm 端最近对焦 0.19 m（1:3.3），70mm 端为 0.38 m。

notes.en: Redesigned 2026 version, far lighter than the 2016 Summilux-SL 50 (584 g vs 1065 g); 11 elements in 6 groups, 11 aperture blades, IP54 sealing. Shipping from the end of 2026.
notes.zh: 2026 年重新设计的版本，比 2016 年款 Summilux-SL 50 轻得多（584 g 对 1065 g）；11 片 6 组、11 片光圈叶片，IP54 防护。2026 年底起发售。

notes.en: First true 1:1 macro lens in the Leica SL system; 801 g without hood (862 g with), IP54 sealing. Shipping from the end of 2026.
notes.zh: 徕卡 SL 系统首支真正 1:1 微距镜头；不含遮光罩 801 g（含遮光罩 862 g），IP54 防护。2026 年底起发售。

notes.en: Compact 142 g ultra-wide prime (model S-S20) sharing the size of the LUMIX S 40mm F2; dust-, splash- and freeze-resistant. Shipping expected from October 2026.
notes.zh: 仅 142 g 的紧凑型超广角定焦（型号 S-S20），外形尺寸与 LUMIX S 40mm F2 相同；防尘防溅防冻。预计 2026 年 10 月开始发货。

notes.en: Budget STM autofocus 50mm with no focus or aperture ring, 12 elements in 8 groups and 7 aperture blades. TTArtisan lists the weight only as a 156-167g range across mounts (upper value used); maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 入门级 STM 自动对焦 50mm 定焦，取消对焦环和光圈环，12 片 8 组、7 片光圈叶片。官方仅给出各卡口 156-167g 的重量区间（此处取上限）；最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Ringless STM autofocus 85mm portrait prime with 12 elements in 8 groups including ED glass and 11 aperture blades. Official weight is a 332-338g range across mounts (upper value used); maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 无对焦环/光圈环设计的 STM 自动对焦 85mm 人像定焦，12 片 8 组（含 ED 镜片），11 片光圈叶片。官方重量为各卡口 332-338g 区间（此处取上限）；最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus all-metal ultra-wide with a 114-degree view, 13 elements in 10 groups including two aspherical elements, and 8 aperture blades. It has no front filter thread; 77mm filters attach via the supplied filter holder. Official weight is 437-445g across mounts (upper value used); maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 全金属手动对焦超广角镜头，114° 视角，13 片 10 组（含 2 片非球面镜片），8 片光圈叶片。无前置滤镜螺纹，77mm 滤镜需通过随附滤镜支架安装。官方重量为各卡口 437-445g（此处取上限）；最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual ultra-wide tilt-shift lens with ±8° tilt, ±8mm shift and 360° rotation, 17 elements in 11 groups and 10 aperture blades; its large image circle also covers medium format. No front filter thread is listed; official weight is 1051-1056g (upper value used) and maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 手动对焦超广角移轴镜头，±8° 倾斜、±8mm 平移，支持 360° 旋转，17 片 11 组，10 片光圈叶片，像场可覆盖中画幅。官方未列出前置滤镜螺纹；官方重量为 1051-1056g（此处取上限），最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Autofocus full-frame diagonal fisheye (MAX series) with a 185-degree view, 11 elements in 8 groups and 9 aperture blades; no front filter thread. The official 504g weight is for the Sony E version (L-mount weight not published), and maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 自动对焦全画幅对角线鱼眼镜头（MAX 系列），185° 视角，11 片 8 组，9 片光圈叶片，无前置滤镜螺纹。官方 504g 重量为索尼 E 卡口版本数据（L 卡口版本重量未公布），最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: STM autofocus 135mm (MAX series) with 16 elements in 13 groups including 6 ED elements, 12 aperture blades and 0.25x maximum magnification. The official 1014g weight is for the Sony E version; the L-mount weight is not published.
notes.zh: STM 自动对焦 135mm 定焦（MAX 系列），16 片 13 组（含 6 片 ED 镜片），12 片光圈叶片，最大放大倍率 0.25x。官方 1014g 重量为索尼 E 卡口版本数据，L 卡口版本重量未公布。

notes.en: Tiny STM autofocus pancake (LITE series) with 7 elements in 6 groups and 9 aperture blades. The official 90g weight is for the Sony E version (L-mount weight not published), and maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 小巧的 STM 自动对焦饼干头（LITE 系列），7 片 6 组，9 片光圈叶片。官方 90g 重量为索尼 E 卡口版本数据（L 卡口版本重量未公布），最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus metal ultra-wide with a 116-degree view, 13 elements in 9 groups, 10 aperture blades and a clicked/de-clicked aperture switch. The 77mm filter thread is on its removable threaded hood; the official 504g weight is for the Sony E version, and maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 全金属手动对焦超广角镜头，116° 视角，13 片 9 组，10 片光圈叶片，光圈环可切换有级/无级。77mm 滤镜螺纹位于可拆卸的螺纹遮光罩上；官方 504g 重量为索尼 E 卡口版本数据，最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Compact manual-focus metal portrait prime with a simple 6-element, 6-group design and 13 aperture blades. The official spec sheet gives about 408g without naming a mount; maximum magnification is an estimate, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 小巧的全金属手动对焦人像定焦，6 片 6 组简洁光学结构，13 片光圈叶片。官方参数表给出约 408g，未区分卡口；最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Second-generation budget 85mm f/1.8 STM autofocus lens with 11 elements in 7 groups, a closer 0.65m minimum focus and a USB-C firmware port; weight about 369g per Meike. Minimum aperture and maximum magnification are estimates, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 第二代平价 85mm f/1.8 STM 自动对焦镜头，11 片 7 组，最近对焦距离缩短至 0.65 米，配备 USB-C 固件升级接口；官方重量约 369g。最小光圈与最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Compact ultra-wide F2.8 zoom from LK Samyang, co-developed with Schneider-Kreuznach; the L-Mount version was announced in April 2026. The f/22 minimum aperture is not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: LK Samyang 与 Schneider-Kreuznach 合作开发的小型 F2.8 超广角变焦，L 卡口版本于 2026 年 4 月发布。最小光圈 f/22 未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Compact telephoto F2.8 zoom from LK Samyang, co-developed with Schneider-Kreuznach; announced June 2026. Maximum magnification is 0.26x at the wide end; the f/22 minimum aperture is not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: LK Samyang 与 Schneider-Kreuznach 合作开发的小型 F2.8 长焦变焦，2026 年 6 月发布。最大放大倍率 0.26x（广角端）；最小光圈 f/22 未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Ultra-wide manual-focus macro announced May 2025 with 0.5x magnification; the L-Mount version has manual aperture control only, unlike the electronically-coupled Sony E/Nikon Z/Canon EF versions.
notes.zh: 2025年5月发布的超广角手动微距镜头，最大放大倍率0.5x；L卡口版本仅支持手动光圈操作，不同于索尼E/尼康Z/佳能EF电子光圈版本。

notes.en: First full-frame constant-f/2.8 zoom fisheye, announced June 2025; gives a circular fisheye at 8mm and a full-frame rectangular fisheye at 15mm. No front filter thread. Manual focus.
notes.zh: 2025年6月发布的世界首款全画幅恒定f/2.8变焦鱼眼镜头；8mm端为圆形鱼眼，15mm端为全画幅矩形鱼眼效果，无前置滤镜螺纹，手动对焦。

notes.en: Laowa's first tele-macro APO lens, announced September 2025. Autofocus on Sony E/Nikon Z/Canon EF; the Leica L and Canon RF versions are manual-focus only, with a wider f/4.5-32 aperture range than the AF versions' f/4.5-22.
notes.zh: 徕沃首款远摄微距APO镜头，2025年9月发布。索尼E/尼康Z/佳能EF版本支持自动对焦；徕卡L卡口和佳能RF版本仅支持手动对焦，光圈范围为f/4.5-32，比自动对焦版本（f/4.5-22）更大。

notes.en: Tilt-shift macro lens announced November 2025, offering ±10° tilt, ±12mm shift and 0.5x magnification with near-zero distortion; includes a built-in Arca-Swiss tripod foot. Manual focus.
notes.zh: 2025年11月发布的移轴微距镜头，提供±10°俯仰、±12mm偏移及0.5x最大放大倍率，畸变极低，内置Arca-Swiss快装脚，手动对焦。

notes.en: Parfocal ultra-macro lens announced July 31, 2026, zooming from 1x to 5x magnification without refocusing; has a 37mm rear (not front) filter thread and no front filter thread, so filterThreadMm is recorded as null here. Weight and minimum working distance are sourced from retailer listings, not a directly fetched official spec page (venuslens.net blocked automated fetches), so treat them as best available rather than fully officially confirmed.
notes.zh: 2026年7月31日发布的准焦式超微距镜头，可在1x至5x放大倍率间变焦而无需重新对焦；采用37mm后置滤镜螺纹（无前置滤镜螺纹，故此处filterThreadMm记为null）。重量和最近工作距离数据来自零售商页面，而非直接抓取到的官方规格页（venuslens.net拦截了自动抓取），请视为最佳可得数据而非完全经官方核实。

notes.en: Parfocal ultra-macro lens announced July 31, 2026, the first lens on the market covering 5x-10x magnification; fixed ~22.5mm working distance throughout the zoom. Weight and dimensions are sourced from retailer/press listings, not a directly fetched official spec page (venuslens.net blocked automated fetches), so treat them as best available rather than fully officially confirmed.
notes.zh: 2026年7月31日发布的准焦式超微距镜头，是市面上首款覆盖5x-10x放大倍率的镜头，变焦过程中工作距离固定在约22.5mm。重量与尺寸数据来自零售商/媒体页面，而非直接抓取到的官方规格页（venuslens.net拦截了自动抓取），请视为最佳可得数据而非完全经官方核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus macro lens dedicated to 1x-5x magnification, sold in many mounts including L-Mount. The official page does not state the aperture range in text, so the minimum aperture value is not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 手动对焦微距镜头，专为 1-5 倍放大倍率设计，有包括 L 卡口在内的多种卡口版本。官方页面未以文字给出光圈范围，最小光圈数值未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Second-generation autofocus 85mm portrait prime, announced October 2025. The official page gives no text spec sheet, so weight, minimum aperture, closest focus and magnification are not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 第二代自动对焦 85mm 人像定焦，2025 年 10 月发布。官方页面没有文字规格表，重量、最小光圈、最近对焦距离和放大倍率均未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame circular fisheye, announced August 2025, with no front filter thread. Weight and magnification are not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅圆形鱼眼镜头，2025 年 8 月发布，无前置滤镜螺纹。重量和放大倍率未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Compact manual-focus full-frame 35mm prime, announced December 2025. Minimum aperture and magnification are not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 小巧的手动对焦全画幅 35mm 定焦，2025 年 12 月发布。最小光圈和放大倍率未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Updated version (model S-R70200A) of the 2019 S-R70200, announced August 2026 and on sale from September 17, 2026. Optics and core specs are unchanged; it adds a fluorine-coated front element and a nameplate redesigned to suppress flare.
notes.zh: 2019 年款 S-R70200 的更新版（型号 S-R70200A），2026 年 8 月发布，9 月 17 日开售。光学结构和主要规格不变，新增前镜片氟涂层，并重新设计了铭牌以抑制眩光。

notes.en: Fast standard prime with a 13-blade aperture; 17 elements in 12 groups. Dust- and splash-resistant with a water- and oil-repellent front element. Release year taken from the A024 edition code, not stated on the product page.
notes.zh: 大光圈标准定焦，13 片光圈叶片，12 组 17 片。具备防尘防滴结构与前镜片防水防油涂层。发布年份依据 A024 版本代码推定，产品页未直接写明。

notes.en: Mirrorless-native 85mm portrait prime with an 11-blade rounded aperture; 15 elements in 11 groups. Dust- and splash-resistant structure. Release year taken from the A020 edition code.
notes.zh: 为无反设计的 85mm 人像定焦，11 片圆形光圈叶片，11 组 15 片。具备防尘防滴结构。发布年份依据 A020 版本代码推定。

notes.en: Second-generation constant-f/2.8 standard zoom; 19 elements in 15 groups. Minimum focus is 17 cm at wide and 34 cm at tele (1:2.7 at wide). Dust- and splash-resistant. Release year taken from the A024 edition code.
notes.zh: 第二代恒定 F2.8 标准变焦，15 组 19 片。最近对焦距离广角端 17cm、长焦端 34cm（广角端最大放大倍率 1:2.7）。具备防尘防滴结构。发布年份依据 A024 版本代码推定。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A015) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued. Bulbous front element with no front filter thread.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A015），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。前镜片外凸，无前置滤镜螺纹。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A015) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A015），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A019) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued. Sigma describes a dust- and splash-resistant structure.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A019），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。官方称具备防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A012) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued. The first Art-line lens; superseded on L-Mount by the 35mm F1.4 DG DN Art.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A012），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。Art 系列首支镜头；L 卡口上已由 35mm F1.4 DG DN Art 取代。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A014) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued. Superseded on L-Mount by the 50mm F1.4 DG DN Art.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A014），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。L 卡口上已由 50mm F1.4 DG DN Art 取代。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A016) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued. Sigma describes a dust- and splash-resistant mount. Superseded by the mirrorless 85mm F1.4 DG DN Art.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A016），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。官方称卡口具备防尘防溅结构。已由无反专用的 85mm F1.4 DG DN Art 取代。

notes.en: DSLR-era Art design (edition A017) that Sigma also produced in native L-Mount; the official page marks it discontinued.
notes.zh: 单反时代的 Art 设计（版本号 A017），适马亦推出过原生 L 卡口版本；官方页面已标注停产。

notes.en: Order no. 11183; 13 elements in 10 groups with nine anomalous-dispersion elements. Weight is about 700 g without the hood (750 g with it); housing is sealed against dust and moisture.
notes.zh: 订货号 11183；13 片 10 组，其中 9 片为反常色散镜片。不含遮光罩约 700 g（含遮光罩约 750 g），镜身防尘防潮。

notes.en: Order no. 11194. The hood is built in, so there is no front filter thread; a rear holder takes gel filters. Largest scale is 1:7.4 at 24 mm.
notes.zh: 订货号 11194。遮光罩为固定式，没有前置滤镜螺纹，可在卡口处的滤镜座使用插片滤镜。最大放大倍率为 1:7.4（24mm 端）。

notes.en: Order no. 11096; has optical image stabilisation and a tripod clamp. Closest focus is 0.65 m at 70 mm and 1.0 m at 200 mm, where the largest scale is 1:5.1. Weight is 1540 g without the hood.
notes.zh: 订货号 11096；带光学防抖和三脚架环。最近对焦距离为 0.65 m（70mm 端）和 1.0 m（200mm 端），最大放大倍率 1:5.1 出现在 200mm 端。不含遮光罩重 1540 g。

notes.en: S-R26 is a pancake lens about 18 mm thick. It is manual focus only with a fixed F8 aperture, so maxAperture equals minAperture. It takes no filters, and Panasonic does not list dust/splash resistance.
notes.zh: S-R26 是一支约 18 mm 厚的饼干镜头。仅支持手动对焦，光圈固定在 F8，因此最大与最小光圈相同。不能装滤镜，官方规格未标注防尘防滴。

notes.en: Compact Air-series full-frame prime with an STM motor and USB-C firmware port; 12 elements in 9 groups (4 ED, 2 HR, 2 aspherical), about 172 g. Viltrox describes the body as sealed for outdoor use; the exact extent of sealing is not specified.
notes.zh: Air 系列小型全画幅定焦，STM 马达，带 USB-C 固件升级接口；12 片 9 组（4 ED, 2 HR, 2 aspherical），约 172 克。官方称其机身具备密封设计，具体密封范围未说明。

notes.en: Compact Air-series full-frame prime with an STM motor and USB-C firmware port; 10 elements in 8 groups (2 ED, 1 HR, 2 aspherical), about 159 g. Official page mentions only a water- and dust-repellent front-element coating, not body sealing.
notes.zh: Air 系列小型全画幅定焦，STM 马达，带 USB-C 固件升级接口；10 片 8 组（2 ED, 1 HR, 2 aspherical），约 159 克。官方仅提及前组镜片的防水防尘镀膜，未说明机身密封。

notes.en: Compact Air-series full-frame prime with an STM motor and USB-C firmware port; 10 elements in 6 groups (1 ED, 3 HR, 1 aspherical), about 169 g. Official page mentions only a water- and dust-repellent front-element coating, not body sealing.
notes.zh: Air 系列小型全画幅定焦，STM 马达，带 USB-C 固件升级接口；10 片 6 组（1 ED, 3 HR, 1 aspherical），约 169 克。官方仅提及前组镜片的防水防尘镀膜，未说明机身密封。

notes.en: Compact Air-series full-frame prime with an STM motor and USB-C firmware port; 13 elements in 9 groups (3 ED, 4 HR, 1 aspherical), about 205 g. Official page mentions only a water- and dust-repellent front-element coating, not body sealing.
notes.zh: Air 系列小型全画幅定焦，STM 马达，带 USB-C 固件升级接口；13 片 9 组（3 ED, 4 HR, 1 aspherical），约 205 克。官方仅提及前组镜片的防水防尘镀膜，未说明机身密封。

notes.en: Manual-focus tilt-shift lens with an f/2 maximum aperture and a 14-blade diaphragm; Laowa's Chinese site lists L-Mount among six mounts. Launched in China in September 2026, ahead of the global release.
notes.zh: 手动对焦移轴镜头，最大光圈 F2，14 片光圈叶片；老蛙中国官网的卡口列表中包含 L 口。2026 年 9 月先在中国发售，早于全球上市。

notes.en: 1:1 macro at 35mm. Autofocus versions exist for E/Z/EF/X, but the L-Mount version is manual focus only (13 aperture blades, 67mm filter, 0.18m close focus). Laowa only publishes weights for the AF versions (530g is the EF figure), so the L-Mount weight is an estimate not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 35mm 焦段 1:1 微距。E/Z/EF/X 卡口为自动对焦版，L 口仅有手动对焦版（13 片光圈叶片、67mm 滤镜、最近对焦 0.18m）。官方只公布了 AF 版重量（530g 为 EF 版数据），L 口版重量为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Near-zero-distortion 12mm (122°) that takes 72mm screw-in filters. Autofocus is offered only for E/Z; the L-Mount version is manual focus, with 5- or 14-blade aperture options. The 480g weight is Laowa's figure for the MF RF version; the L-Mount weight and release year are not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 近乎零畸变的 12mm（122°）超广角，可直接安装 72mm 螺纹滤镜。自动对焦版仅有 E/Z 卡口，L 口为手动对焦版，可选 5 片或 14 片光圈叶片。480g 为官方公布的 MF RF 版重量，L 口版的重量与发布年份未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus 1:1 telephoto macro; Zhongyi lists Leica L among its mounts. The 1,300g weight is the official figure, which does not say which mount it applies to.
notes.zh: 手动对焦长焦 1:1 微距镜头；中一光学官网的卡口列表中包含 Leica L。1300g 为官方重量，未注明对应哪个卡口。

notes.en: Manual-focus super-telephoto with 8 elements in 5 groups (2 ED) and a tripod collar. TTArtisan lists weight only as about 1564-1617 g across mounts (upper bound used); maximum magnification is an estimate - not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 手动对焦超长焦镜头，8 组 5 片中含 2 片 ED 镜片，附脚架环。官方仅给出各卡口约 1564-1617g 的重量区间（此处取上限）；最大放大倍率为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus 2x macro (non tilt-shift version) with 14 elements in 10 groups. TTArtisan lists weight only as about 700-748 g across mounts (upper bound used), not verified through official channels for L-Mount.
notes.zh: 手动对焦 2 倍微距镜头（非移轴版），14 组 10 片。官方仅给出各卡口约 700-748g 的重量区间（此处取上限），L 卡口重量未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame fast standard prime, 12 elements in 7 groups. Meike does not publish magnification (estimated), and the release year refers to the lens line; the L-Mount version's launch date is not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅大光圈标准定焦，12 片 7 组。美科未公布放大倍率（此为估算），发布年份为该系列首发年份，L 卡口版的上市时间未能通过官方渠道核实。

notes.en: Compact manual-focus full-frame standard prime, 6 elements in 5 groups. Magnification and release year (lens line, not specifically the L version) are estimates, not verified through official channels.
notes.zh: 小巧的手动对焦全画幅标准定焦，6 片 5 组。放大倍率和发布年份（指该系列而非 L 卡口版）为估算值，未能通过官方渠道核实。
